create_filter_pipeline: create a filter pipeline scaffold that intercepts form data before it is sent to the OpenAI API
configure_pipeline_valves: configure pipeline valves with target model pipelines list and execution priority level
run_pipeline_inlet: run the pipeline inlet method to filter and transform request body with optional user context
check_title_generation: check if the request body contains a title generation flag in the pipeline inlet handler
setup_pipeline_lifecycle: setup pipeline on_startup and on_shutdown lifecycle hooks for server start and stop events
